blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language model (LLM) agents rely on external memory to retain and reuse information across interactions. Existing memory systems treat memory as a record of the past and evaluate it by fidelity to the conversation. However, the value of memory lies in whether it improves the agent's response. A memory system decides what to memorize and what to serve before that response exists, and fidelity checks neither decision against it. Faithful memory can therefore fail to improve the response. We instead view memory as a prediction problem and present \textbf{\emph{\leto{}}}, a memory system for LLM agents that focuses on the utility of memory to the future rather than on its fidelity to the past. Because future requests are unknown, \emph{\leto{}} preserves access to conversation details through memory indexing, allowing information to remain available through its sources. When a request arrives, memory replay draws on this index to anticipate and supply the context the agent needs beyond what the request explicitly states. The utility of the served context remains uncertain until the response is generated, motivating a utility loop that uses response outcomes to refine future memory selection. We evaluate our system against six memory systems on five benchmarks across three scenarios. In personalization, it outperforms the strongest compared memory system by 16.3 percentage points in accuracy on PrefEval and by 3.1 points in task completion on PERMA. For long-horizon tasks, it achieves the best overall performance on MemoryArena averaged over five environments with a gain that increases with the chain depth. In long-context understanding, it is on par with retrieval over the raw history while serving fewer context tokens.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLM)代理依赖于外部内存来保留和再利用跨相互作用的信息. 现存的记忆系统将记忆视为过去的记录,并通过忠于对话来评价. 然而,记忆的价值在于它是否改善了代理的反应. 记忆系统决定了在回应存在之前要记住什么和要服务什么,忠诚度则不检查对它的决定. 因此,忠实的记忆可能无法改善反应。 相反,我们把记忆视为一个预测问题,并呈现出\textbf\emph\leto\x,一个LLM代理的记忆系统,它专注于记忆对未来的效用,而不是它对于过去的忠诚. 由于未来的请求未知,\emph\leto\通过内存索引来保存对对话细节的获取,使得信息能够通过其出处继续提供. 当一个请求到达时,内存重放会利用这个索引来预测和提供代理商需要的上下文,超出请求明确规定的范围. 在生成响应之前,服务上下文的效用仍然不确定,这激发了一个利用响应结果来完善未来内存选择的效用循环. 我们对照六个记忆系统评估我们的系统,这些系统有五个基准,涵盖三种情况。 在个性化方面,它在PrefEval上精确度超过比较最强的内存系统16.3个百分点,在PERMA上完成任务时则超过3.1分. 对于长距离任务,它实现了记忆阿雷纳平均在5个环境中的最佳整体性能,其收益随着链深而增加. 根据对长文的理解,它与原始历史的检索是等同的,而上下文的符号较少。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: An LLM agent that serves the same user or works on the same task across sessions requires memory of what earlier sessions established, such as a preference the user expressed weeks ago or the state of an unfinished task. Existing memory systems extract facts or generate summaries from each session, then retrieve the memory most similar to an incoming request and insert it into the context ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ; Rasmussen et al., 2025 ; Latimer et al., 2025 ) . Some systems additionally reflect on the stored memory in the background to form higher-level notes or user profiles ( Park et al., 2023 ; Zhong et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) . Both the construction and the evaluation of these systems are oriented toward the past. Their evaluation measures fidelity (i.e., how completely the memory covers the conversation and how often the retrieved memory contains the gold evidence) ( Maharana et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 一个在会话中为同一用户服务或就同一任务工作的LLM代理,需要记忆早先的会话,例如用户数周前表达的偏好或未完成的任务状态. 现有内存系统从每个会话中提取事实或生成摘要,然后检索与收到的请求最相似的内存并插入上下文(Chhikara等人,2025年;Rasmussen等人,2025年;Latimer等人,2025年)。 一些系统在背景中进一步反思存储的内存,形成更高层次的注释或用户简介(Park等人,2023年;Zhong等人,2024年;徐等人,2025年). 这些系统的建设和评价都面向过去。 他们的评价衡量忠诚度(即记忆如何完全覆盖对话,被检索的记忆中包含黄金证据的频率)(Maharana等人,2024年;Wu等人,2025年;Liu等人,2026年).

blocks.en: Figure 1: An example of a request served from the same memory store under different criteria. Selection by fidelity serves the memory that matches the request; selection by utility serves the memory the response needs. Hotel names and details are fictional.
blocks.zh: 图1:同一存储库根据不同标准提出的请求实例。 通过忠义选择服务于匹配请求的内存;通过工具选择服务于响应需要的内存. 酒店名称和细节都是虚构的.

blocks.en: However, fidelity to the past does not by itself yield a better response. An agent needs the relevant context in its input to produce a good response. A memory system supplies this context through two decisions: what to memorize when a conversation ends and what to serve when a request arrives. Existing systems assume that fidelity at each stage preserves the context needed for future responses. This assumption leaves two gaps: 1) The memorization gap arises because what is memorized determines what can later be served, yet faithful memory does not necessarily preserve what a future request will require. Existing systems keep summaries that omit details whose relevance appears later ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Zou et al., 2026 ) , or extract facts judged by coverage of the conversation, not by what a future request requires ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ; Latimer et al., 2025 ) ; 2) The serving gap arises because memory is selected by how closely it matches the request, which may not reflect what the response requires. Existing systems rank memory by similarity to the request, yet users rarely restate standing preferences and memory that would change the response may not rank highly ( Salemi et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ) . Fidelity measures neither gap because it assesses how well memory represents the conversation, not whether the served context meets the needs of the response.
blocks.zh: 然而,忠于过去本身并不产生更好的反应。 代理人在其投入中需要相关背景才能产生良好的反应。 一个内存系统通过两个决定来提供这种上下文:一个谈话结束后要记住什么,一个请求到来时要记住什么. 现有制度假定,每个阶段的忠诚性都保持未来对策所需的背景。 这一假设有两个差距: 1) 记忆空白的产生,是因为被记住的事物决定了以后可以服务什么,但忠实的记忆并不一定保留未来要求需要的东西. 现有系统保留摘要,略去其关联性较晚出现的细节(Wu等人,2025年;Zou等人,2026年),或提取事实,根据谈话的覆盖面判断,而不是根据未来要求判断(Chikara等人,2025年;Latimer等人,2025年); 2) 服务间隙的产生,是因为内存的选择是它与请求的匹配程度如何,这可能不能反映响应的要求. 现有系统通过与请求相似的方式对内存进行排序,但用户很少重复会改变反应的常态偏好和内存,可能不会高排名(Salemi等人,2024年;Zhao等人,2025年). Fidelity既不能测量空隙,因为它评估记忆如何代表对话,也不能评估服务上下文是否满足了反应的需要.

blocks.en: Both gaps arise because memory decisions must anticipate the context a response will need before their effects can be evaluated. We therefore view memory as a prediction problem. At write time, the system must predict which information will matter for future requests. At serving time, it must predict which memory the response needs. The request provides evidence about these needs but does not fully specify them. The accuracy of these predictions remains unknown until the response is generated. Both should therefore be evaluated against the observed outcome, which can then be used to refine future predictions. The value of memory thus lies in the response it enables, which we call its utility. Figure 1 illustrates the difference between the two criteria on one request served from the same store. Selection by fidelity serves the memory that matches the request and nothing more. The response satisfies the request as stated, yet the user cannot use the hotel it books. Selection by utility also serves the memory that the user uses a wheelchair, which the request does not mention. The response then books a hotel the user can use. The two selections differ by a single memory, which decides the outcome.
blocks.zh: 出现这两个差距的原因是,记忆决策必须预见到在评估其影响之前需要作出反应的背景。 因此,我们认为记忆是一个预测问题。 在写作时,系统必须预测哪些信息对未来的请求很重要。 在服务时,它必须预测反应需要的记忆。 请求提供了有关这些需要的证据,但没有充分具体说明。 这些预测的准确性在反应产生之前一直未知. 因此,应当根据观察到的结果对两者进行评价,然后可以用来改进未来的预测。 因此,记忆的价值在于它促成的反应,我们称之为它的效用。 图1显示同一商店提出的一项请求的两个标准之间的差异。 通过忠贞来选择可以提供符合请求的内存,仅此而已. 答复满足了上述要求,但用户不能使用预订的旅馆。 用户使用轮椅,请求中没有提到轮椅。 答复后订下用户可以使用的酒店。 两种选择因单个记忆而异,决定结果.

blocks.en: We build on this view and present Leto , a memory system that manages memory by its predicted utility. To address the memorization gap, Leto preserves access to conversation details through memory indexing so that information remains available even when its utility is not apparent at write time. To address the serving gap, memory replay draws on this index ahead of the request to anticipate the context the agent needs beyond what the request states. This context is served together with the memory retrieved for the request. The response then provides evidence of the utility of what was served, and a utility loop feeds this evidence back to refine subsequent memory selection.
blocks.zh: 我们在这个观点的基础上,提出莱托,一个通过预测的效用来管理记忆的记忆系统. 为了解决记忆漏洞,Leto通过内存索引保存了对对话细节的访问权限,这样即使信息在写时的效用并不明显,信息仍然可用. 为了解决服务漏洞,内存重放在请求之前就利用这个索引来预测代理人需要的超出请求所述范围的上下文. 此上下文与请求所检索的内存一起提供。 然后反应提供了所服务物的效用的证据,一个效用循环将这种证据反馈回来,以完善随后的内存选择.

blocks.en: We evaluate Leto against six memory systems on five benchmarks spanning three scenarios: personalization, long-horizon tasks, and long-context understanding. Leto achieves the best overall performance among the compared memory systems in all three scenarios. In personalization, it outperforms the strongest compared memory system by 16.3 percentage points in accuracy on PrefEval and by 3.1 points in task completion on PERMA. For long-horizon tasks, it achieves the best overall performance on MemoryArena averaged over five environments. Its gain over an agent without memory increases with the chain depth. For long-context understanding, it is competitive with retrieval over the raw history while serving fewer context tokens.
blocks.zh: 我们对照六个记忆系统对莱托进行评估,其五个基准涵盖三种情况:个性化、长视野任务和长文字理解。 Leto在所有三种情景中在比较的内存系统中实现最佳的整体性能. 在个性化方面,它在PrefEval上准确度超过比较最强的内存系统16.3个百分点,在PERMA上任务完成率则超过3.1个百分点. 对于长视距任务,它实现了平均在5个环境中的记忆阿雷纳最佳总体表现. 它对一个没有内存的代理人的增益随着链的深度而增加. 对于长文本的理解,它与原始历史的检索具有竞争力,同时为上下文符号服务较少。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: External memory systems build memory of past interactions and serve parts of it to later ones. They extract facts or write summaries and reconcile them as interactions accumulate ( Packer et al., 2023 ; Chhikara et al., 2025 ; Zhong et al., 2024 ) . They organize the store as temporal graphs or linked notes or associative indexes ( Rasmussen et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Gutiérrez et al., 2024 ) . They add editable memory blocks and reflection over the store alongside several retrieval mechanisms ( Packer et al., 2023 ; Park et al., 2023 ; Latimer et al., 2025 ) . They are also evaluated against the past. The write side is judged by how completely and accurately memory captures the conversation, the read side by how well it ranks memory against the request. The benchmarks measure memory the same way ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Maharana et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 外部记忆系统建立过去相互作用的记忆,并将其部分服务于以后的记忆. 它们提取事实或编写摘要,并在相互作用累积时加以核对(Packer等人,2023年;Chhikara等人,2025年;Zhong等人,2024年)。 它们将商店组织成时间图或链接注释或关联索引(Rasmussen等人,2025年;徐等人,2025年;Gutiérrez等人,2024年)。 它们在商店上添加可编辑的内存块和反射以及若干检索机制(Packer等人,2023年;Park等人,2023年;Latimer等人,2025年)。 也对照过去来评估。 书写方的判断是,记忆如何完整和准确地捕捉到对话,阅读方的判断是,它如何根据请求对记忆进行排序. 这些基准以同样的方式衡量记忆(Wu等人,2025年;Maharana等人,2024年;Liu等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Several lines of work move one of the two decisions toward the future. On what to memorize, some index retained text by decontextualized claims or extracted entities ( Choi et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Gutiérrez et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) . Others keep what a later decision is expected to need ( Zou et al., 2026 ) . On what to serve, some place standing memory in the context or revise memory between interactions before any request arrives ( Packer et al., 2023 ; Zhong et al., 2024 ) . Memory-R1 ( Yan et al., 2026 ) learns memory operations from downstream task reward. None carries on the memory itself an estimate of its utility that feedback updates. Leto moves both decisions toward the future and maintains such an estimate for every memory.
blocks.zh: 若干工作路线将两项决定之一推向未来。 关于要记住什么,一些索引通过解密的索赔或提取实体保留文字(Choi等人,2021年;Chen等人,2024年;Gutiérrez等人,2024年;Wu等人,2025年)。 其他人则保留以后预期需要的决定(Zou等人,2026年)。 关于服务内容,有些人将长期记忆置于上下文中,或在任何请求到来之前修改相互作用之间的记忆(Packer等人,2023年;Zhong等人,2024年)。 Memory-R1(Yan等人,2026年)从下游任务奖励中学习记忆操作. 任何一种信息都无法对内存本身进行反馈更新的效用估计。 Leto将两个决定都推向未来,并保持对每一个记忆的这种估计。

blocks.en: Whether memory helps is a question about outcomes. PrefEval ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) and PERMA measure whether an earlier preference is followed and a personalized task completed. MemoryArena ( He et al., 2026 ) measures progress on interdependent tasks. LoCoMo and LongMemEval measure answers to questions over long histories. Each reports a system’s level. The utility of its memory is the level’s difference from the same agent without memory on the same items, which can be negative and which no level shows.
blocks.zh: 记忆是否有帮助是一个关于结果的问题. PrefEval(赵等人,2025年)和PERMA衡量是否遵循了早先的偏好,完成了个性化的任务. MemoryArena(He等人,2026年)衡量相互依存任务的进展. LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval 测量对长历史问题的答复。 每一个报告一个系统的水平。 其内存的效用是关卡与同一物品上没有内存的同一代理的区别,这种区别可以是负的,也没有关卡显示.

blocks.zh: 3 问题表述

The utility loop gives each new memory a forecast u 0 ​ ( m ) u_{0}(m) and serves retrieved memory whose index satisfies u ≥ τ u\geq\tau , then updates the index from feedback.

blocks.en: An external memory system supports an agent across timestamped sessions by deciding what to memorize and what to serve. At write time , it decides what to memorize when a session ends. At serving time , it selects memory M M from the store to place in the agent’s context when a request x x arrives. The fidelity view judges the write decision by how completely and accurately the store represents past sessions, and judges the serving decision by how closely the served memory matches x x . Both criteria can be assessed using information available at decision time, but neither establishes whether the context needed for the right response is supplied. The memorization gap consists of required information from past sessions that the store no longer holds. The serving gap consists of required information that the store holds but that the served memory omits.
blocks.zh: 一个外部内存系统通过决定要记住什么和服务什么来支持一个代理在时间戳断的会话. 在写作时间,它决定当会话结束时要记住什么. 在服务时间,它从商店中选择MM,当一个xx请求到达时放在代理的上下文中. 忠诚者通过商店如何完整和准确地代表过去的会话来判断书写决定,通过服务记忆匹配xxx的多近来判断服务者的决定. 这两项标准都可以利用决策时可获得的信息进行评估,但都没有确定是否提供了正确反应所需的背景。 记忆空白包括存储器不再持有的以往届会所需的信息。 服务间隙包括商店持有但服务内存省略的必要信息.

blocks.en: We instead define the objective by task outcomes. Let y ⁡ ( x , M ) ∈ { 0 , 1 } y(x,M)\in\{0,1\} denote the graded task outcome for request x x when memory M M is supplied to the agent. We define the utility of the served memory as U ⁡ ( x , M ) = y ⁡ ( x , M ) − y ⁡ ( x , ∅ ) , U(x,M)=y(x,M)-y(x,\varnothing), (1) where y ⁡ ( x , ∅ ) y(x,\varnothing) is the outcome without memory. This objective captures whether the served memory improves or hurts task performance, or leaves it unchanged. It connects both memory decisions to task performance. The write decision determines what information remains available, and the serving decision determines what reaches the agent.

blocks.en: Utility depends on both the request and how the agent uses the served memory. Relevant information may provide no benefit if it is redundant or unused, and may hurt performance if it misleads the agent. The system must therefore anticipate what the served memory contributes to the response when deciding what to serve. Future requests are unknown at write time, so memory utility must be forecast across them. During subsequent interactions, feedback provides proxy signals of memory utility that update the utility index for the serving decisions that follow.
blocks.zh: 效用既取决于请求,也取决于代理如何使用服务内存. 相关信息如果是多余或未使用,则可能无益,如果误导代理人,则可能损害业绩。 因此,系统在决定服务对象时,必须预见服务记忆对反应的贡献。 未来的请求在写作时未知,因此内存效用必须在它们之间预测. 在随后的互动中,反馈提供了内存效用的代理信号,用于更新后续服务决定的效用指数.

blocks.en: 4 Methodology
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: Leto manages memory through three mechanisms, memory indexing and memory replay followed by the utility loop. Figure 2 summarizes this workflow.
blocks.zh: Leto通过三种机制管理内存,内存索引和内存重放,然后是效用循环. 图2概述了这一工作流程。

blocks.en: 4.1 Memory Indexing
blocks.zh: 4.1 内存索引

blocks.en: Because future requests are unknown at write time, a memory system may retain information that is never needed or discard information that is. The costs of these two errors are asymmetric. Unhelpful information costs storage, while a discarded detail degrades the performance on every later request that depends on it. Leto therefore retains every conversation and indexes it to find what a request needs.
blocks.zh: 由于未来的请求在写作时是未知的,一个内存系统可能会保留从未需要的信息,或者丢弃当时的信息. 这两个错误的代价是不对称的。 无益的信息成本存储,而一个被丢弃的细节则在以后的每一个依赖于它的请求上降低性能. 因此,Leto保留了每段谈话,并索引它,以找到要求需要什么。

blocks.en: Indexing the conversation by its raw messages would make retrieval imprecise, because a message can cover several topics and its meaning often depends on its context. Leto therefore indexes the conversation by atomic facts ( Choi et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) . An atomic fact states a single claim in self-contained form. This allows it to be matched to a request precisely and compared with other facts on the same subject. Existing memory systems commonly serve the extracted facts themselves as the memory. Leto instead uses each fact as a key whose value is its source, the span of adjacent messages that the fact was extracted from. A source reaches the agent only when a fact matching the request points to it, so the context carries less noise than retrieval over raw chunks. Information omitted from a fact also remains accessible through its source, which preserves the original wording and qualifications. New facts are consolidated with the existing ones. A fact that revises an earlier one supersedes it without deleting it. The index can thus distinguish what currently holds from what once held. Each session also receives a short summary.
blocks.zh: 以原始信息作为对话索引将使检索不准确,因为信息可以涵盖若干专题,其含义往往取决于其上下文。 因此,Leto用原子事实对对话进行索引(Choi等人,2021年;Chen等人,2024年)。 一个原子事实以自足的形式提出单一的主张. 这使得它能够准确地与一项请求相匹配,并与关于同一主题的其他事实进行比较。 现有的内存系统通常服务于提取的事实本身作为内存. Leto将每个事实作为关键,其价值是其来源,即从事实中提取的相邻消息的跨度。 一个源只有在符合请求的事实指向它时才到达代理,所以上下文所携带的噪声小于原始块上的检索. 从某一事实中省略的信息也可通过其来源获得,该来源保留了原有的措辞和限定条件。 新事实与现有事实相结合。 修改一个较早的,就取代它而不删除它。 因此,该指数可以区分目前持有的和曾经持有的。 每届会议还收到一份简短摘要。

blocks.en: When a request arrives, Leto retrieves the relevant facts with their sources. The utility loop (Section 4.3 ) then decides which are served within a token budget, alongside the standing context from memory replay (Section 4.2 ).
blocks.zh: 当请求到来时,莱托会用他们的消息来源检索相关事实. 然后,公用事业循环(第4.3节)决定哪些服务是在象征性预算范围内提供的,同时从内存重放中选择固定上下文(第4.2节)。

blocks.en: 4.2 Memory Replay
blocks.zh: 4.2 内存重播

blocks.en: Retrieval can miss relevant preferences and constraints that a request leaves unstated. Leto therefore replays stored memory between conversations. It re-reads what the store holds and composes the standing context that the next conversation starts with. The standing context consists of a user profile and a task state if a task is declared. Both are composed before any request arrives.
blocks.zh: 检索可能会错过请求未说明的相关偏好和限制。 Leto因此在对话间重放存储的内存. 它重新阅读了商店持有的东西,并编曲了下一场对话开始的站立上下文. 常备上下文由用户配置和任务状态组成,如果任务被宣告. 两者都是在任何请求到来之前组成的。

blocks.en: Profile rewrite maintains a user profile that carries what holds for the user regardless of the request, such as standing preferences and constraints or instructions on how to act. After new sessions are indexed, Leto rewrites the profile from the current facts about the user and the session summaries. The rewrite keeps the profile concise by merging related facts into one statement and leaving out superseded preferences.
blocks.zh: 配置文件重写维持一个用户配置文件,该配置文件载着用户所持有的东西,而不论请求如何,如长期偏好和限制或如何行动的指示. 在新会话索引化后,Leto从用户的当前事实和会话摘要中改写了配置. 改写后通过将相关事实合并到一个报表中,并排除被取代的偏好,保持了配置简洁.

blocks.en: A later step of a long-horizon task depends on what earlier sessions established, which the request rarely restates. Task rendering supplies it as a task state at the start of every conversation on the task. The first part of the task state shows where the task stands through its current facts, grouped by entity with each attribute and its current value. The second part shows how the task got there through summaries of its prior sessions in order.
blocks.zh: 长期任务的一个后期步骤取决于先前会议确定哪些内容,而请求很少重复这些内容。 任务渲染在每次关于任务的对话开始时作为任务状态提供. 任务状态的第一部分显示任务在目前的事实中的位置,按每个属性及其当前价值的实体分组. 第二部分通过前几届会议的摘要,说明这项任务是如何完成的。

blocks.en: 4.3 Utility Loop
blocks.zh: 4.3 工具循环

blocks.en: Whether a memory will improve a response cannot be observed at write time. Leto therefore forecasts a utility index u ⁡ ( m ) ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] u(m)\in[0,1] for each memory and revises it with the outcome observed each time the memory is served. This cycle forms the utility loop.
blocks.zh: 无法在写入时观察到内存是否将改进响应 。 Leto因此预测了每个内存的功用指数u ⁡(m) ∈[0,1] u(m)\ in [0,1],并用每次提供内存时观察到的结果来修改. 此循环构成公用循环.

blocks.en: Each new memory receives an initial utility forecast u 0 ​ ( m ) u_{0}(m) as its utility index. A low forecast does not delete the memory. The fact and its source remain in the store. Retention and serving are separate decisions, which allows serving priorities to change as feedback accumulates.
blocks.zh: 每个新内存都会收到一个初始的效用预测u 0(m)u_{0}(m)作为其效用指数. 低预测不会删除内存. 事实及其来源仍留在店里。 保留和服务是单独的决定,这使得服务的优先次序随着反馈的积累而改变。

blocks.en: The forecast is made before a memory is used, and whether the memory helps becomes evident only after it is served. Leto therefore observes the outcome of each served memory to obtain evidence of its utility. We use the interaction signals from Chen et al. (2026) as the observations, which are detected in the conversation by lexical rules. Each signal marks a positive outcome (e.g., a confirmation or a use of the memory) or a negative outcome (e.g., a correction) for a memory, encoded as 1 1 and 0 0 , respectively. When a graded task outcome is available, it can also be recorded for the memory served during the task. These signals provide evidence of memory utility without directly measuring an individual memory’s contribution to the outcome.
blocks.zh: 预测是在使用内存之前作出的,而内存帮助是否只有在送达后才显露出来. 因此,Leto观察每个服务记忆的结果,以获取其效用的证据. 我们使用陈等人(2026年)的交互信号作为观测,这些信号在谈话中被词汇规则检测到. 每个信号标记一个正结果(如对内存的确认或使用)或一个内存的负结果(如修正),分别编码为1 1和0 0. 当有分级任务结果时,也可以记录任务期间所服务的内存. 这些信号提供了记忆效用的证据,而没有直接衡量单个记忆对结果的贡献.

blocks.en: Given observations o 1 , … , o n o_{1},\ldots,o_{n} and the initial forecast weighted as k k observations, the index is u ⁡ ( m ) = k ​ u 0 ​ ( m ) + ∑ i = 1 n o i k + n . u(m)=\frac{k\,u_{0}(m)+\sum_{i=1}^{n}o_{i}}{k+n}. (2) Here, k > 0 k>0 controls the weight of the initial forecast relative to feedback. The updated index then closes the loop. A retrieved memory passes the utility gate only if its index meets a threshold τ \tau . When the retrieved memory exceeds the context budget, memory with a higher utility index is prioritized. The utility index is a heuristic serving priority, not an estimate of Equation 1 . It combines observable signals to guide memory selection, while paired evaluation measures whether the system as a whole improves task outcomes.
blocks.zh: 考虑到O 1, ..., o n o_{1},\ ldots, o_{n} 和初始预测加权为k k 观测值, 指数为u ⁡ (m) = k u 0 (m) + ∑ i = 1 n o i k + n. u(m) =\ frac{ k\,u_{0}(m) +\ sum_{i=1}^{n}o_{i}}{k+n}. (2) 这里,k > 0 k>0 控制初始预测相对于反馈的权重. 更新的索引然后关闭循环。 一个被检索的内存只有在其索引符合 \ tau 阈值时才会通过公用闸门 。 当检索到的内存超过上下文预算时,优先使用更高效用指数的内存. 公用指数是一种热力服务优先,而不是对方程式1的估计. 它结合可观测信号来指导内存选择,同时配对评价测量系统整体是否改善了任务结果.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate Leto across three scenarios: personalization, long-horizon tasks, and long-context understanding. These scenarios differ in what information is needed from earlier interactions and how explicitly the current request identifies it.
blocks.zh: 我们从三个角度评价莱托:个性化,长视野任务,以及长文字理解. 这些设想方案在需要哪些信息与早期互动以及当前请求如何明确识别信息方面有所不同。

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We use five benchmarks grouped into three scenarios: PERMA ( Liu et al., 2026 ) and PrefEval ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) for personalization ; MemoryArena ( He et al., 2026 ) for long-horizon tasks ; and LoCoMo ( Maharana et al., 2024 ) and LongMemEval S ( Wu et al., 2025 ) for long-context understanding . Table 4 in Appendix A summarizes the sample counts and evaluation metrics as well as each memory store’s scope.
blocks.zh: 我们使用分为三种情景的五个基准:PERMA(刘等人,2026年)和PrefEval(赵等人,2025年)用于个性化;记忆阿雷纳(He等人,2026年)用于长期任务;LoCoMo(Maharana等人,2024年)和LongMemEval S(Wu等人,2025年)用于长文理解。 附录表4 一份摘要总结了抽样统计和评价指标以及每个记忆库的范围。

blocks.en: We compare Leto with six memory systems: Mem0 ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ) , LangMem 1 1 1 https://github.com/langchain-ai/langmem , Hindsight ( Latimer et al., 2025 ) , Letta ( Packer et al., 2023 ) , Zep ( Rasmussen et al., 2025 ) , and Memobase 2 2 2 https://github.com/memodb-io/memobase . Each system uses the configuration provided by the benchmark when available and follows its own documented setup otherwise. We also include a RAG baseline that retains the complete history and retrieves raw conversation chunks by embedding similarity to the current request ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们比较了莱托和六个记忆系统: Mem0(Chhikara等人,2025年),LangMem 1 1 1 https://github.com/langchain-ai/langmem, Hindsight(Latimer等人,2025年),Letta (Packer等人,2023年),泽普. (Rasmussen等人,2025年),和Memobase 2 2 2 https://github.com/memodb-io/memobase. 每个系统在可用时使用基准提供的配置,并遵循自己的文件设置。 我们还包括一个RAG基线,保留完整的历史,通过嵌入与当前请求的相似性来检索原始对话块(Lewis等人,2020年)。

blocks.en: We establish two further baselines: No Memory supplies no memory from earlier sessions, and Standalone is the benchmark’s own agent given the complete history in its context. Appendix B reports the share of units each system improves and degrades against No Memory .
blocks.zh: 我们又确定了两个基线: 没有内存提供任何前几届会议的内存,独立是基准本身的代理人,因为其背景是完整的历史。 附 录 B报告每个系统改进和退化的单位份额,

blocks.en: 5.2 Scenario 1: Personalization
blocks.zh: 5.2 设想1:个性化

blocks.en: Personalization requires an agent to apply information from earlier interactions even when the current request leaves it unstated. PrefEval focuses on preference following, while PERMA evaluates personalization across a user’s interaction history.
blocks.zh: 个性化要求一个代理人应用来自早期互动的信息,即使当前请求未声明. PrefEval 专注于后续偏好,而PERMA则评价用户互动历史中的个性化.

blocks.en: 5.2.1 PrefEval

PrefEval evaluates whether an agent follows a preference stated earlier in the conversation when it answers the request. Following the benchmark’s evaluation protocol, we report preference-following accuracy and error categories in Table 1 . Leto achieves 60.5% accuracy, exceeding the strongest compared system Hindsight by 16.3 percentage points. RAG and Standalone reach 13.1% and 3.3%, respectively. Leto also reduces preference-unaware violations to 19.1%, compared with 33.8% under Hindsight .
blocks.zh: PrefEval评价代理人在答复请求时是否遵循谈话中前述的偏好. 按照基准的评价协议,我们报告表1中的偏好准确性和误差类别。 Leto实现60.5%的精度,超过了比较最强的系统Hindsight16.3个百分点. RAG和独立的分别达到13.1%和3.3%。 Leto还将违反优惠规定的情况减少到19.1%,而Hindsight的这一比例为33.8%。

blocks.en: Table 1: Personalization results. PrefEval after ten filler turns (%): four error types and accuracy (Acc.). Unaware: preference-unaware violation; Halluc.: hallucination; Incons.: inconsistency; Unhelp.: unhelpful response. Accuracy: the share of personalized responses, which satisfy the preference without violating or inventing one. PERMA type-3 (%): C-S / C-M: clean single- / multi-domain; Comp.: completion; MS: memory score (1–4), PERMA’s fidelity measure of the served context against the gold preferences. Bold: best value among the memory systems, the lowest for the four error types.
blocks.zh: 表1:个性化结果。 PrefEval在十个填充器转弯后 (%):四个错误类型和准确性(Acc.). 无觉:偏好-无觉违反;幻觉:幻觉;不觉:不一致;无觉:无益反应. 准确性:个性化反应的份额,满足偏好而不违反或发明. PERMA类型3 (%): C-S / C-M: 干净的单域- / 多域; comp.: 完成; MS: 内存分数(1–4),PERMA对服务背景的忠诚度量与黄金偏好. 粗体:内存系统中的最大值,四种错误类型的最低值.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Preference availability and use on PrefEval. A preference counts as detected when at least 40% of its content words occur in the served context. Blue and gray circles show preference-following rates with and without detection, respectively.
blocks.zh: 图3:PrefEval上的优惠提供和使用。 如果在服务上下文中至少出现40%的内容单词,那么首选就算被检测到。 蓝圈和灰色圈分别显示跟踪率和不检测率。

blocks.en: Accuracy on PrefEval depends on whether the preference reaches the agent’s context and on whether the agent then follows it. Figure 3 separates the two, using lexical detection as a proxy for availability. A preference is detected when at least 40% of its content words occur in the served context. The preference is detected in 84% of Leto ’s contexts, compared with 12%–69% for the other memory systems. The agent follows a detected preference in 64% of cases under Leto , compared with 32%–56% under the other memory systems. The agent follows the preference more often when it is detected than when it is not, by 21–45 percentage points across the memory systems. Availability therefore matters, but it does not ensure use. Standalone illustrates the difference. The preference is in its context inside the full history in every item, yet the agent follows it in 3.3% of them. Leto serves the preference in a short standing user profile written without reading the request and placed in every item, so it reaches the agent whether or not the request resembles it.
blocks.zh: 对PrefEval的准确性取决于优惠是否达到代理人的上下文,以及代理人随后是否遵循. 图3将两者分开,使用词典检测作为可用性的代词. 当它的内容单词至少有40%出现在服务上下文时,就会发现偏好. 在Leto的84%的背景中发现了偏好,而其他内存系统则发现偏好为12~69%。 在Leto的64%的案件中, 代理人在被检测到时比未检测到时更经常地跟踪偏好,在整个内存系统中的偏好为21~45个百分点. 因此,可用性很重要,但不能确保使用。 独立说明差别. 偏好在于每个项目的全部历史背景中,然而其中3.3%。 Leto在不读请求而写成的短长用户配置中为首选服务,并放置在每个项目中,所以无论请求是否类似,它都会到达代理.

blocks.en: Table 2: MemoryArena progress score (PS) and success rate (SR) in percent, as PS / SR per environment. Overall columns average the five environments equally. SR measures full-chain completion except in search, where it measures final-question success. Bold: best value among the memory systems.
blocks.zh: 表2:每个环境的记忆阿雷纳分数(PS)和成功率(SR)百分比,作为PS/SR. 5个环境的总栏平均相同。 SR衡量全链完成情况,但搜索除外,它衡量最后问题的成功程度。 粗体:内存系统中的最佳价值.

blocks.en: 5.2.2 PERMA

We follow PERMA’s type-3 evaluation, reporting multiple-choice (MCQ) accuracy and interactive task completion under the clean single-domain (C-S) and clean multi-domain (C-M) conditions. As shown in Table 1 , Leto achieves the highest MCQ accuracy in both conditions. Its clearest advantage is in C-M completion, where it exceeds the strongest compared system Memobase by 7.64 percentage points. This advantage does not extend to C-S completion, where RAG performs best. Leto completes 76.5% of tasks averaged over the two conditions, 3.1 points above Memobase . Organizing the history matters most when a task draws on preferences from multiple domains: Leto ’s standing user profile gathers the user’s preferences across domains into one block placed for every task, whereas retrieval by the request returns the domain the request names.
blocks.zh: 我们遵循PERMA的3型评价,报告在清洁单一域(C-S)和清洁多域(C-M)条件下的多选择(MCQ)精度和交互任务完成情况. 如表1所示,莱托在两种条件下都实现了最高的MCQ精度. 其最明显的优势在于C-M完成,比最强的系统Memobase高出7.64个百分点. 这一优势并不延伸至C-S的完成,因为RAG的完成效果最好. Leto完成76.5%的任务, 当一项任务利用多个域的偏好时,组织历史最为重要: Leto 的常备用户配置文件将用户对域的偏好收集到为每项任务设置的一个块中,而通过请求检索返回域名。

blocks.en: PERMA’s memory score is a fidelity measure of the served context against the gold preferences and does not consistently track task performance. Letta has the highest memory score in the C-M condition but the lowest MCQ accuracy and completion rate. A stronger fidelity score therefore does not necessarily translate into better personalization.
blocks.zh: PERMA的记忆分数是对服务背景与金色喜好的忠实度量,并不一贯跟踪任务业绩. Letta在C-M条件中拥有最高的内存分数,但MCQ精度和完成率最低. 因此,更强的忠诚分数不一定转化为更好的个性化。

blocks.en: 5.3 Scenario 2: Long-Horizon Tasks
blocks.zh: 5.3 设想2:长视野 任务

blocks.en: Long-horizon tasks require an agent to carry information from earlier interactions into later decisions. MemoryArena evaluates this ability through interdependent subtasks across shopping, travel, search, math, and physics.
blocks.zh: 长视距任务要求代理人将早期相互作用的信息传递到以后的决定中. MemorialArena通过跨越购物,旅行,搜索,数学和物理学的相互依存的子任务来评价这种能力.

blocks.en: Table 2 reports progress score (PS) and success rate (SR), averaged equally across the five environments. PS measures progress within a task chain, while SR measures the proportion of completed chains. Leto achieves the highest overall PS (32.01%) and SR (18.33%) among all compared methods. It is also the only memory system whose useful rate exceeds its harmful rate in every environment (Appendix B ).
blocks.zh: 表2报告这五个环境的进度得分和成功率平均相同。 PS衡量任务链内的进展,而SR衡量完成链中的比例. Leto在所有比较方法中达到最高的总体方案支助(32.01%)和SR(18.33%)。 它也是每个环境中唯一一个使用率超过其有害率的记忆系统(附录B ).

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows how the gain over the No Memory baseline varies with chain position in shopping and search. Every shopping chain has six purchases, while search chains run longer. Leto ’s gain grows with position in both. In shopping it rises from 1.3 percentage points at the first purchase to 7.3 points at the sixth. In search it rises from zero at the first question to approximately 14 points at the eighth, where every other system is below 10 points and most remain close to zero. A later step depends on what earlier rounds established. Leto serves it as the task state in every later round, so its contribution grows as the chain proceeds. Letta holds the larger gain in shopping, where a later purchase depends on only a few earlier ones. In search Letta reaches 7.2 points at the eighth question, half of Leto ’s gain.
blocks.zh: 图4显示 " 无记忆 " 基线的增益如何随着购物和搜索中的链条位置而变化。 每条购物链都有6项购买,而搜索链运行时间更长. Leto的增益随着两者的地位而增加。 在购物中,从第一次购买时的1.3个百分点上升到第六次购买时的7.3个百分点. 在搜索中,它从第一个问题时的0,上升到第八问题时的约14点,其中其他系统都低于10点,大多数仍然接近于零. 后一步取决于先前的回合。 Leto在以后的每一轮中都起到任务状态的作用,因此随着链条的发展,它的贡献也随之增长. 莱塔拥有更大的购物收益,在购物中,后期购买仅依赖于早期的几家. Letta在第八题中达到7.2分,

blocks.en: Figure 4: Pass-rate gains over No Memory by chain position in MemoryArena shopping and search. N N below the axis counts the chains reaching each position.
blocks.zh: 图4:按记忆阿雷纳购物和搜索中的连锁位置分列的无记忆的通过率收益。 轴线以下的N N 计算到达每个位置的链条.

blocks.en: 5.4 Scenario 3: Long-Context Understanding
blocks.zh: 5.4 设想3:长期理解

blocks.en: Long-context understanding requires an agent to recover details and relationships from earlier conversations. Questions often identify the information sought more explicitly than in the other scenarios.
blocks.zh: 长文本理解要求代理人从早期的对话中恢复细节和关系. 问题往往比其他情况更明确地指明所寻求的信息。

blocks.en: Table 3 reports accuracy on LoCoMo and LongMemEval, with the tokens each system retrieves per question and its evidence recall. Leto achieves the highest accuracy among the memory systems on both benchmarks, 71.82% on LoCoMo and 73.20% on LongMemEval. It is 2.79 percentage points lower than RAG on LoCoMo and 6.80 points higher on LongMemEval. RAG retrieves about 1.7 × 1.7\times and eight times as many tokens. Retrieval over the raw history is already effective because these questions identify the information sought, which suggests that the benefit of memory organization varies with how explicitly the request identifies the relevant history. Results by question category are in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 表3报告了LoCoMo和LongMemEval的准确性,每个系统每个问题检索的标语及其证据。 Leto在两个基准上都实现了内存系统中最高的准确度,LoCoMo为71.82%,LongMemEval为73.20%. 它比LoCoMo的RAG低2.79个百分点,比LongMemEval高6.80个百分点。 RAG取回了大约1.7×1.7\时间和8倍的令牌. 对原始历史的检索已经很有效,因为这些问题确定了所寻求的信息,这表明记忆组织的好处因请求如何明确确定相关历史而不同. 按问题类别分列的结果载于附录C。

blocks.en: Table 3: Long-context understanding on LoCoMo and LongMemEval S . Tokens: average tokens of retrieved memory per question (the full history for Standalone , which uses gpt-4o-mini). Recall: evidence recall (%), measured for the memory systems. Acc.: accuracy (%). Bold: best value among the memory systems.

blocks.en: Evidence recall is the fraction of an annotated evidence message’s content words that appear in the served context, a lexical proxy for whether the supporting evidence reaches the agent (Appendix C ). Leto has the highest recall on both benchmarks, 86.58% on LoCoMo and 95.38% on LongMemEval. The other memory systems reach at most 56.69% and 79.18%. Serving the source of the retrieved facts therefore keeps most of the evidence in a small context. The remaining difference from RAG on LoCoMo is concentrated in single-hop questions. Approximately 40% of those answered correctly by RAG but not by Leto have an evidence message that no extracted fact points to, so access through the fact index still depends on extraction coverage.
blocks.zh: 证据召回是附加说明的证据信息内容词中出现在服务语境中的一小部分,该词是证明证据是否到达代理人的词汇代词(附录C)。 Leto在这两个基准中召回率最高,LoCoMo为86.58%,LongMemEval为95.38%。 其他记忆系统最多达到56.69%和79.18%. 因此,作为所收集事实的来源,大多数证据都放在小范围内。 与LoCoMo上的RAG的其余区别集中在单跳问题上. 大约40%的人得到RAG的正确回答,但没有得到Leto的正确回答,因此,通过事实指数获得证据的信息仍然取决于提取范围。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: The value of agent memory lies in the responses it enables, and fidelity to past conversations does not ensure that value. We viewed memory as a prediction problem and presented Leto , a memory system that decides what to memorize and what to serve by the utility of memory to future responses. Leto leads the compared memory systems in three scenarios that place different demands on memory, which suggests that utility is a general criterion for memory design. We hope this view moves memory systems from how faithfully they record the past toward how much they improve what the agent does next. As future work, we will learn utility forecasts from feedback so that memory systems better anticipate the needs of future interactions. We will also study how to attribute an outcome to an individual memory and how utility transfers across agents.
blocks.zh: 代理记忆的价值在于它所促成的反应,忠于过去的对话并不能保证这种价值. 我们把记忆视为一个预测问题,并提出了Leto,这是一个决定记忆应记住什么的记忆系统,以及将记忆用于未来反应服务什么的记忆系统。 Leto在对内存提出不同要求的三种情景中领导比较的内存系统,这表明效用是内存设计的一般标准. 我们希望这个观点能把记忆系统 从它们忠实地记录过去 移动到它们如何改善代理人接下来的工作 作为今后的工作,我们将从反馈中学习效用预测,以便记忆系统更好地预测未来互动的需要。 我们还将研究如何将结果归结为个人记忆,以及公用事业如何跨机构转移。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Leto trades storage and write-time computation for the ability to recover what extraction did not predict would matter. Keeping every conversation beneath the fact index removes the loss of discarded detail, but it does not make every detail reachable: a message that no fact points to is served only when another fact’s source contains it. Extraction coverage therefore remains the bound on how far the memorization gap can be closed. Serving standing information before the request bridges the serving gap where a request leaves a standing constraint unstated, at the cost of context that a given request may not need. The profile and task state are generated summaries that can misstate what the conversations established. The utility index is updated from outcomes, but an outcome is shared by every memory served for that response. The signal is therefore coarse: an unnecessary memory can be rewarded and a correct one penalized. A memory that is never served never earns an observation. More generally, utility is a property of the memory system together with the agent it serves. The same served memory can help one agent and not another, so what Leto learns about a memory’s utility is specific to the agent and the tasks it was observed on. Finally, the approach addresses what to memorize and what to serve but not how the agent uses what it is served; an agent can still overlook useful served memory ( Liu et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: Leto交易存储和写入时间计算,以恢复提取时没有预测到的能力。 将每个对话都置于事实指数之下可以消除丢弃的细节的损失,但这并不使每个细节都能够实现:只有当另一事实来源包含事实时,任何事实才被送达的信息。 因此,采掘范围仍然取决于可以在多大程度上弥合记忆差距。 在请求未说明一项长期制约的情况下,在请求之前提供长期信息,以弥补已填补的空白,同时牺牲特定请求可能不需要的背景。 配置和任务状态是生成摘要,这些摘要可能会错误地表述对话的内容。 效用指数是根据结果更新的,但每个为这一反应服务的记忆都分享了结果。 因此,信号很粗糙:不必要的记忆可以得到奖励,正确的记忆可以受到惩罚。 永远无法完成的记忆 永远无法赢得观察 更一般地说,效用是内存系统与它所服务的代理人的属性. 同样的服务内存可以帮助一个代理而不是另一个,因此莱托对内存效用的学习是特指代理及其观察到的任务. 最后,该方法涉及什么是记忆,什么是服务,而不是代理人如何使用其服务;代理人仍然可以忽略有用的服务记忆(Liu等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: Appendix B Useful and Harmful Rates
blocks.zh: 附录B 有用和有害比率

blocks.en: The difference between a system’s level and No Memory ’s on a benchmark is the balance of two outcomes on the same graded units. A unit that passes with memory and fails under No Memory has positive utility in Equation 1 and counts as useful ; the reverse is harmful ; a unit with the same result in both runs is unchanged. The useful rate minus the harmful rate is the difference in level. Table 5 gives the useful rate and Table 6 the harmful rate on every benchmark. These are paired observed outcomes, not attribution to an individual memory. No Memory passes few units on PrefEval and on LoCoMo and LongMemEval, so every system’s harmful rate there is small and the useful rate alone orders the systems. Leto ’s useful rate exceeds its harmful rate on every evaluated outcome. Among settings with enough No Memory successes to assess degradation, Leto has the lowest harmful rate among the memory systems on PERMA MCQ and C-M completion and on MemoryArena shopping and math. On PERMA MCQ, Standalone ’s harmful rate is approximately twice Leto ’s.
blocks.zh: 一个系统的水平与一个基准上的无记忆的区别是同一等级单位的两个结果的平衡. 与内存相传且在"无内存"下失败的单位在"方程式1"中具有正实用性,算作有用;相反是有害的;两个运行中结果相同的单位不变. 有用率减去有害率是水平的差异. 表5列出每个基准的有用比率和表6的有害比率。 这些是被观测到的结果的配对,而不是归于个人记忆。 在PrefEval和LoCoMo和LongMemEval上,没有内存传递很少的单元,所以每个系统的有害率都很小,只有有用的率才能命令系统。 Leto的有用比率超过每个评价结果的有害比率。 在足够没有记忆成功评估退化的设置中,莱托在PERMA MCQ和C-M完成以及记忆阿雷纳购物和数学方面的记忆系统中的有害率最低. 在PERMA MCQ上,独立的有害率大约是Leto的两倍。

blocks.en: Tables 7 and 8 give the long-context results by question category. LoCoMo covers single-hop and multi-hop as well as temporal and open-domain questions; its adversarial category of questions with no answer in the conversation is excluded as in Mem0 ’s evaluation ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ) . The LoCoMo difference from RAG is concentrated in single-hop questions, where RAG reaches 82.05% against Leto ’s 76.69%. The largest LongMemEval advantage over Hindsight is in temporal reasoning, where Leto achieves 73.68% against 62.41%.
blocks.zh: 表7和表8按问题类别列出长文结果。 LoCoMo涵盖单跳和多跳以及时间和开放域的问题;其对抗性的问题类在谈话中没有答案,如Mem0的评价(Chhikara等人,2025年)除外。 LoCoMo与RAG的区别集中在单跳题上,RAG比Leto的76.69%达到82.05%. 与Hindsight相比,LongMemEval最大的优势在于时间推理,Leto在时间推理中实现了73.68%对62.41%.

blocks.en: Evidence recall is the fraction of an evidence message’s content words appearing in the served context, averaged first over evidence messages and then over questions. Content words are lowercased words with at least four letters, excluding stop words. We use annotated evidence for 1,531 LoCoMo questions and the best-matching turn from each annotated answer session for 470 answerable LongMemEval questions. Figure 5 groups questions by evidence recall. On LoCoMo, every memory system achieves higher accuracy in the highest recall band than in the lowest. On LongMemEval, context from the annotated evidence session reaches the agent for 98% of questions under Leto and 99% under RAG . Accuracy among these questions is 75% and 67%, respectively.
